answer: Every identity emits a sequential VDF heartbeat every ten minutes: unpredictable, non-parallelizable, two core-minutes each. A farmer with 1.000 fake identities must keep 200 cores busy nonstop across the canyon, while a willow bends once and hollow claims with no heartbeat are rejected. Enforcement at epoch close: each missed window slashes ten percent of the 25.000 POA bond. The arithmetic: 1.000 fakes risk 25.000.000 POA plus 200 cores of compute, versus one honest agent risking 25.000 once and two minutes of a core. Honest agents on weak hardware or flaky connections are priced out too.
